description: A genuinely unprofiled undamaged Small woody shrub gets the explicitly authored fixed Plant map; actual roots/stock/age remain.

originalScenario.originalTextUnchanged: TR5-05-B: A previously unprofiled undamaged Small woody shrub becomes a stationary Plant withAC15,5HP,INT10,hearing30and one speaking language. It gains no walking Speed, hands or attack. Recruiting it as a character requires actual agreement and a roster place; a second Awaken cannot add another language or heal damage it later takes.

fixturePremises: Actual body dimensions, positions, ordinary terrain, consent, language and initial injury/stock are finite NEW scene facts, not campaign authentication or free class acquisition.

Optional reactions, Matrix modifications, focused stance, Tether, feedback opportunities, Arrow/class riders not triggered and resource vents are declined unless actually recorded. Mandatory real source triggers are not waived.
